competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply to a different item category, or refer to an exchange window rather than a full-refund window.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current policy specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, such as 14 days, 60 days, or no full-refund window.
